# experiment 3 phase 2 results (generated by experiments/exp3/exp3_phase2.py)

Post-hoc analysis: second use of 2018-2019. Does not replace experiment 2's verdict. Plan: PLAN_phase2.md.

train <= 2017: 8127 rows; evaluate 2018-2019: 7515 rows / 1421 papers; resamples 1000; raw bootstrap_phase2_20261004_000925.csv; candidate counts identical to experiment 2 in 1001/1001 replicates; unseen subset skipped in 0 replicates (< 10 candidates)

**primary (LightGBM − kNN Spearman, lower bound > 0): MET** — +0.162 (95% +0.054 to +0.271)

supporting 1 (LightGBM Spearman > 0): met — 0.419 (0.315–0.524)

supporting 2 (LightGBM process-only Spearman > 0): met — 0.329 (0.206–0.442)

supporting 4 (LightGBM top-10% gain, %p): +1.62 (+0.37 to +2.78)

verdict sentence (pre-set): 모델 순위가 비슷한 레시피 평균보다 실제 효율 순위와 더 잘 맞았다 (사후 분석).
